Turns one of the 6 clip planes of a camera on or off. The plane itself is set with [SetCameraClipPlane](SetCameraClipPlane) and is kept while it is off. All planes of a new camera are off. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
@param camera  Camera handle.
@param index  Which plane, from 0 to 5.
@param enabled  True to cut with the plane, False to stop.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
cube = CreateCube()
PositionEntity cube, 0, 0, 5
SetCameraClipPlane camera, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0
While Not KeyHit(1)
	; Hold space to cut away the left half of the cube.
	SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled camera, 0, KeyDown(57)
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Wend
```
